questions.q: A switch with `RC8_OPTION = 28` (relay 1) was at 1810 µs, with the relay on. After a trim adjustment on the transmitter the channel became 1795 µs. What does ArduPilot 4.7.2 do?
options: Nothing: there is hysteresis between 1200 and 1800 µs, and the HIGH position is held
After 200–300 ms it turns the relay off: 1795 µs is MIDDLE
It turns the relay off only after the channel drops below 1200 µs
It reports `Invalid channel option` and leaves the relay as it was
questions.explain: There is no hysteresis: HIGH is strictly above 1800 µs, and everything from 1200 to 1800 inclusive is MIDDLE (`read_3pos_switch`). A change of position is executed after the 200 ms debounce, and for a relay HIGH turns it on and the other positions turn it off.

questions.q: Aux channels are read at the 0, 100, 200 ms marks and so on. An E-Stop switch (`31`) went to HIGH at 4010 ms and came back to LOW at 4190 ms. When do the motors stop?
options: At 4100 ms, on the first tick after the flick
At 4210 ms, 200 ms after the flick
At 4300 ms, 200 ms after the tick on which the HIGH position was first seen by the firmware
They do not stop: at the 4200 mark the channel is in LOW again and the count is reset
questions.explain: At the 4100 mark the new position is seen and the time is remembered; at the 4200 mark the channel already equals the current position, LOW, and `debounce_completed` resets the wait. A pulse shorter than two polling ticks is not executed.

questions.q: The transmitter is switched on with the `RC7_OPTION = 153` (ArmDisarm) switch in HIGH and the `RC9_OPTION = 4` (RTL) switch in HIGH. What happens 200 ms after the first receiver frame?
options: An arm and an attempt to engage RTL
Only an attempt to engage RTL; no arm, since the position of the 153 switch is only remembered
Nothing: on the first receiver frame every function without exception only remembers its position
Only an arm: modes are not switched at boot
questions.explain: `init_position_on_first_radio_read` returns `true` only for 153, 154, 165, and 22. The other functions execute the current position after 200 ms, because the remembered position of a channel is initially −1.

questions.q: In flight the pilot bumped a switch with `RCx_OPTION = 31` (Motor Emergency Stop), and the channel went to HIGH. What does Copter 4.7.2 do?
options: It ignores it: the function works only on the ground
It reduces throttle smoothly and lands in LAND mode
It zeroes the motor outputs immediately; the vehicle stays armed, and the auto-disarm delay is halved
It disarms, just like a 153 switch in LOW, logs an event, and refuses to arm again until the next reboot
questions.explain: `SRV_Channels::set_emergency_stop(true)` zeroes the outputs of the motor functions with no check of altitude or mode; there is no disarm, but `DISARM_DELAY` is divided by two (`motors.cpp`). Putting the switch back in LOW before the auto-disarm starts the motors again.

questions.q: `RC9_OPTION = 31`, `RC9_REVERSED = 1`, `RC_OPTIONS = 32`. In which switch position do the motors stop?
options: Above 1800 µs: the switch reversal has no effect without bit 7 in `RC_OPTIONS`
Below 1200 µs: `RCx_REVERSED` reverses any channel regardless of the `RC_OPTIONS` bits
In the middle position
In none: a reversed channel disables the function
questions.explain: `read_3pos_switch` takes `RCx_REVERSED` into account only when bit 7 (128, Allow Switch reverse) is set. 32 is bit 5. You need `RC_OPTIONS = 160` or a reversal on the transmitter.

questions.q: `RC6_OPTION = 219`, `RC6_MIN = 1100`, `RC6_MAX = 1900`, `TUNE = 4`, `TUNE_MIN = 0.05`, `TUNE_MAX = 0.25`. The knob is at 1750 µs. What is `ATC_RAT_RLL_P`?
questions.explain: The fraction of travel is (1750 − 1100) / (1900 − 1100) = 0.8125; the value is 0.05 + 0.2 · 0.8125 = 0.2125. You get 0.20 if you take a travel of 1000…2000 instead of `RC6_MIN…RC6_MAX`; 0.135 is the saved value, which the knob knows nothing about.

questions.q: In flight the knob was used to find `ATC_RAT_RLL_P = 0.18` (`TUNE = 4`). After landing the pilot switched off the power. What is in the parameter at the next power-up with the knob in the same position?
options: 0.18 from storage: tuning saves the value on disarm
The value saved before tuning, and it stays that way until the pilot moves the knob by at least 1%
First the value saved before tuning, then 0.18 from the knob again, as long as `TUNE` is not 0
`TUNE_MIN`, until the knob is moved through the middle
questions.explain: Tuning writes only to the in-memory copy (`set_kP`), so the old value is loaded from storage. But `TUNE` is still 4, and the calculation, 3 times per second, sets the value from the knob position again. To keep the result, write the value from the ground station and set `TUNE = 0`. Passing through the middle is required on Plane, not on Copter.

questions.q: You need to tune D in flight on roll only; right now `ATC_RAT_RLL_D = 0.0036` and `ATC_RAT_PIT_D = 0.0052`. Which set is safe?
options: `TUNE = 21`, `TUNE_MIN = 0`, `TUNE_MAX = 0.01`
`TUNE = 48`, `TUNE_MIN = 0.0036`, `TUNE_MAX = 0.0036`
questions.explain: 51 changes only the roll D; a ±20% range around 0.0036 puts the original value at the middle of the travel. 21 would write one number to both axes and wipe out the 0.0052 on pitch; 48 is pitch, and with equal `TUNE_MIN` and `TUNE_MAX` tuning is off in 4.7.

questions.q: Plane, `TUNE_PARAM = 101`, `TUNE_RANGE = 2`. The pilot raised the selector (`TUNE_SELECTOR`) to HIGH for 3 seconds and released it. What happened?
options: The current value became the new center point (`Tuning: recentered`)
It moved to the next parameter of the set (`Tuning: started …`)
The set's values were saved (`Tuning: Saved`)
The unsaved values were reverted (`Tuning: reverted`)
questions.explain: `check_selector_switch`: a hold of 0.2–2 s sets a new center, 2–5 s moves to the next parameter, and longer than 5 s (while the selector is still in HIGH and the value has changed) saves. A revert is done by a mode change with `TUNE_MODE_REVERT = 1`.

questions.q: A Lua script calls `rc:get_aux_cached(300)` right after the flight controller boots; the `RC10_OPTION = 300` switch is in LOW, and the transmitter is still off. What does the call return?
options: 0, the switch is in LOW
`nil`, the function has not been called yet
1, the middle position by default
A script error: the channel is invalid while there is no link to the transmitter
questions.explain: The position cache is filled in `run_aux_function`. Functions 300–315 are not called at initialization; the first call happens 200 ms after the first receiver frame. Until then `get_aux_cached` returns `nil`, and the script has to handle that.
